racialSpecialty.name: Balance in All Things (Kenti)
racialSpecialty.description: Kenti who are in Balance receive a +1 bonus to all attributes aside from their primary attribute. A Kenti is in balance if all of their attributes aside from their primary attribute are within 1.5 of the average of those attributes.
